targets.rawSql:
SELECT
COALESCE(SUM(total),0)
FROM traffic_logs
WHERE timestamp::date=CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT

date_trunc('minute',timestamp) as time,

AVG(total) as vehicle_count

FROM traffic_logs

GROUP BY 1

ORDER BY 1;
SELECT SUM(car) AS car, SUM(motorcycle) AS motorcycle, SUM(bus) AS bus, SUM(truck) AS truck FROM traffic_logs

SELECT

CASE

WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM timestamp)<=5

THEN 'Weekday'

ELSE 'Weekend'

END day_type,

AVG(total)

FROM traffic_logs

GROUP BY day_type;

SELECT

timestamp,

camera_id,

car,

motorcycle,

bus,

truck,

total

FROM traffic_logs

ORDER BY timestamp DESC

LIMIT 20;
